header: THE ONE PLACE where I write the nicknames and groupings of the departments (step 45a). Pure data, no logic: to teach the search a new nickname, add or edit ONE line here. A group says: when a question contains one of these ALIASES (as whole words; capitals and punctuation do not matter), the department means ALL the rows of the live list whose normalised name STARTS WITH one of the PREFIXES (a whole word: "hr" finds "HR (NW)" but not "HRX") or begins with one of the STEMS (part of a word: "fire service" also finds "FIRE SERVICES"). The people sit in the SECTION rows, so asking for the department means all its sections; I tell the model to use department_id IN (the ids), and to use one row only when the person names one section. Normalised means lower case, "&" read as "and", every other mark a space: "M&HS(1)" is "m and hs 1", "S.M.S. ELECT.MAINT." is "s m s elect maint". Departments NOT listed here still work when named by their own name (the part before the bracket): ACVS includes "ACVS - OFFICE", L & D includes "L & D IND" and "L & D OFFICE", FOUNDRY its 12 sections ... (context.ts departmentFamilies). Use this file for what the NAMES cannot tell: a nickname (cocc, W&A, hydraulic lab), a department known by another word (health centres, public health and PMU sit in the main hospital), a variant spelling (FIRE SERVICE / FIRE SERVICES, ETL / ELECTRICAL TECHNICAL LAB). I rely on the test departmentAliases.selftest.ts to check this file against a saved copy of the 300 real rows (src/lib/nl2sql/__fixtures__/departments.real.json): an entry that matches no row, an alias claimed by two groups and a changed row count all fail the test, so the file cannot go stale unnoticed.
